subject.title: Feature: configurable bootstrap file injection order for prompt cache optimization

question: Should OpenClaw accept bootstrapDynamicFiles/bootstrapFileOrder as a core config surface, or expose this through a context-engine/plugin hook contract instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates a durable prompt/cache and config API with compatibility implications that automation should not choose.

options.title: Accept narrow core config
options.body: Add bootstrapDynamicFiles and optional bootstrapFileOrder with unchanged defaults, schema/docs/tests, and explicit prompt-cache semantics.

options.title: Extend plugin/context contract
options.body: Add or document the minimal hook/context-engine API needed for external code to classify dynamic files and order bootstrap context.

options.title: Decline new control
options.body: Keep the fixed heartbeat-only dynamic split and document cost/workaround guidance for operators with volatile workspace files.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow core config
recommendation.body: Add bootstrapDynamicFiles and optional bootstrapFileOrder with unchanged defaults, schema/docs/tests, and explicit prompt-cache semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available owner for the product/API contract choice because his related history covers bootstrap cache semantics and current AI runtime extraction work.
